newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity details reasons for board change.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity details reasons for board change.

text.p: Anglo-U.S. systems manufacturer LucasVarity said on Monday that its new group finance director Neil Arnold would devote himself to pursuing the company's global expansion plans.
The group announced earlier that Arnold was replacing John Grant as finance director.
"Arnold was found more global in outlook...," a company spokesman said in a telephone interview.
Grant's contract with the company was terminated from last Friday, the spokesman said.
Arnold was the chief financial officer of Varity Corporation of the U.S. before its merger with UK's Lucas Industries earlier this year.
The company said an unspecified package had been paid to Grant in compensation for the ending of his contract.
The spokesman said Arnold was preferred for the post on the basis of his experience in North America.
LucasVarity announced earlier this month that it was selling off its businesses in 13 non-core areas resulting in the loss of 3,000 jobs worldwide over two years.
The restructuring is expected to save 120 million stg.
